labels.text: This speciﬁcation describes an optimized expression ofthe semantics ofthe Hypertext Transfer
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Protocol (HTTP), referred to as HTTP version 2 (HTTP/2). HTTP/2 enables a more eﬃcient use of
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Both endpoints have a subjective view ofthe state of a stream that could be diﬀerent when
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: frames are in transit. Endpoints do not coordinate the creation ofstreams; they are created
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: unilaterally by either endpoint. The negative consequences of a mismatch in states are limited to
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: the "closed" state after sending RST_STREAM, where frames might be received for some time after
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: closing.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Streams have the following states:
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: idle: All streams start in the "idle" state.
labels.rationale: Definition-list term "idle:" run into its definition (state description, not a heading)

labels.text: The following transitions are valid from this state:
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Sending a HEADERS frame as a client, or receiving a HEADERS frame as a server, causes
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: the stream to become "open". The stream identiﬁer is selected as described in Section 5.1.1.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: The same HEADERS frame can also cause a stream to immediately become "half-closed".
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Sending a PUSH_PROMISE frame on another stream reserves the idle stream that is
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: identiﬁed for later use. The stream state for the reserved stream transitions to "reserved
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: (local)". Only a server may send PUSH_PROMISE frames.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Receiving a PUSH_PROMISE frame on another stream reserves an idle stream that is
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: identiﬁed for later use. The stream state for the reserved stream transitions to "reserved
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: (remote)". Only a client may receive PUSH_PROMISE frames.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Note that the PUSH_PROMISE frame is not sent on the idle stream but references the
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: newly reserved stream in the Promised Stream ID ﬁeld.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Opening a stream with a higher-valued stream identiﬁer causes the stream to transition
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: immediately to a "closed" state; note that this transition is not shown in the diagram.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: Receiving any frame other than HEADERS or PRIORITY on a stream in this state MUST be
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: treated as a connection error (Section 5.4.1) oftype PROTOCOL_ERROR. Ifthis stream is
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: initiated by the server, as described in Section 5.1.1, then receiving a HEADERS frame MUST
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: also be treated as a connection error (Section 5.4.1) oftype PROTOCOL_ERROR.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: reserved (local): A stream in the "reserved (local)" state is one that has been promised by
labels.rationale: Definition-list term "reserved (local):" run into its definition

labels.text: sending a PUSH_PROMISE frame. A PUSH_PROMISE frame reserves an idle stream by
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: associating the stream with an open stream that was initiated by the remote peer (see Section
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page
Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: In this state, only the following transitions are possible:
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • The endpoint can send a HEADERS frame. This causes the stream to open in a "half-closed
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: (remote)" state.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Either endpoint can send a RST_STREAM frame to cause the stream to become "closed".
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: This releases the stream reservation.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: An endpoint MUST NOT send any type offrame other than HEADERS, RST_STREAM, or
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: PRIORITY in this state.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

Section number "10.5." (part of the heading)

labels.text: Denial-of-Service Considerations
labels.rationale: Section title "Denial-of-Service Considerations"

labels.text: An HTTP/2 connection can demand a greater commitment ofresources to operate than an HTTP/
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: 1.1 connection. Both ﬁeld section compression and ﬂow control depend on a commitment of a
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: greater amount ofstate. Settings for these features ensure that memory commitments for these
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: features are strictly bounded.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: The number ofPUSH_PROMISE frames is not constrained in the same fashion. A client that
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: accepts server push SHOULD limit the number ofstreams it allows to be in the "reserved (remote)"
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: state. An excessive number ofserver push streams can be treated as a stream error (Section 5.4.2)
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: oftype ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: A number ofHTTP/2 implementations were found to be vulnerable to denial ofservice
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: [NFLX-2019-002]. Below is a list ofknown ways that implementations might be subject to denial-
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: of-service attacks:
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Ineﬃcient tracking of outstanding outbound frames can lead to overload if an adversary
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: can cause large numbers offrames to be enqueued for sending. A peer could use one of
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: several techniques to cause large numbers offrames to be generated:
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: ◦ Providing tiny increments to ﬂow control in WINDOW_UPDATE frames can cause a sender
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: to generate a large number ofDATA frames.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: ◦ An endpoint is required to respond to a PING frame.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: ◦ Each SETTINGS frame requires acknowledgment.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: ◦ An invalid request (or server push) can cause a peer to send RST_STREAM frames in
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: response.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • An attacker can provide large amounts ofﬂow-control credit at the HTTP/2 layer but
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: withhold credit at the TCP layer, preventing frames from being sent. An endpoint that
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: constructs and remembers frames for sending without considering TCP limits might be
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: subject to resource exhaustion.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Large numbers ofsmall or empty frames can be abused to cause a peer to expend time
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: processing frame headers. Caution is required here as some uses ofsmall frames are entirely
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: legitimate, such as the sending of an empty DATA or CONTINUATION frame at the end of a
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: stream.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • The SETTINGS frame might also be abused to cause a peer to expend additional processing
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: time. This might be done by pointlessly changing settings, sending multiple undeﬁned
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: settings, or changing the same setting multiple times in the same frame.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Handling reprioritization with PRIORITY frames can require signiﬁcant processing time and
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: can lead to overload ifmany PRIORITY frames are sent.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Field section compression also provides opportunities for an attacker to waste processing
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: resources; see Section 7 of [COMPRESSION] for more details on potential abuses.
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: • Limits in SETTINGS cannot be reduced instantaneously, which leaves an endpoint exposed to
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page

labels.text: behavior from a peer that could exceed the new limits. In particular, immediately after
labels.rationale: Default: body text, list item, table cell, page number or other non-heading content on this page
